title: A Wandering Merchant
text: A merchant with a creaking cart stops in your village, hawking trinkets from distant lands.

choices.label: Haggle for a bargain
choices.result: You drive a hard bargain and he grudgingly respects you.

choices.label: Listen to his tales of far-off places
choices.result: His stories open your mind to a wider world.

choices.label: Ignore him
choices.result: You go about your day.

title: A Stray Dog
text: A thin, wary dog follows you home from the edge of the woods.

choices.label: Share your food and befriend it
choices.result: The dog never leaves your side, and you learn to read its moods.

choices.label: Shoo it away
choices.result: It slinks back into the trees.

title: The Village Bully
text: An older boy corners you behind the granary and demands what little you have.

choices.label: Fight back
choices.result: It is a messy scuffle.

choices.label: Talk him down
choices.result: Words work where fists would not.

choices.label: Run for it
choices.result: You are faster than he is.

title: A Strange Old Book
text: Beneath a loose floorboard you find a leather-bound book written in a script you half recognise.

choices.label: Study it in secret
choices.result: Months of careful study teach you something, though not without a chill.

choices.label: Burn it before it can do harm
choices.result: Some knowledge is better left in the fire.

title: Wolves in the Woods
text: A low growl stops you on the forest path. Yellow eyes watch from the undergrowth.

choices.label: Stand and fight
choices.result: Teeth and fury, and somehow you drive them off.

choices.label: Climb the nearest tree
choices.result: You wait out the pack, stiff and shaken.

choices.label: Slip away quietly
choices.result: You melt into the shadows.

title: Fever in the Village
text: A wasting fever sweeps through the village. Neighbours fall ill, and the healers are overwhelmed.

choices.label: Help tend the sick
choices.result: You do what you can, and people remember it.

choices.label: Stay indoors and wait it out
choices.result: The fever passes you by.

title: A Tournament at the Fair
text: Banners go up for a martial tournament. The winner earns a purse, and a name.

choices.label: Enter the contest
choices.result: You fight bravely, win or lose.

choices.label: Watch and learn from the fighters
choices.result: You study every feint and footwork.

title: The Hermit on the Hill
text: Smoke rises from a hut high on the hill. They say a hermit there knows things.

choices.label: Climb up and ask to be taught
choices.result: He teaches you to quiet your mind.

choices.label: Laugh at the old fool
choices.result: You return home pleased with yourself, and no wiser.

title: The Harvest Festival
text: Lanterns, music and long tables fill the village square.

choices.label: Join the dancing
choices.result: You laugh until your sides ache.

choices.label: Help bring in the harvest
choices.result: Honest labour, honest sweat.
